subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should cron quarantine recovery retain prior archived entries across repeated overflows, or is replacing the sole archive intentionally acceptable for this persisted diagnostic state?
rationale: The patch makes an irreversible retention-policy choice that bounds disk use by overwriting historical quarantine contents; source and tests do not establish that this data is safely disposable.

options.title: Retain bounded history
options.body: Keep a bounded archive set or compact retained entries so repeated overflow does not silently erase prior quarantine evidence.

options.title: Accept single-archive replacement
options.body: Document that quarantine history is disposable and explicitly accept replacement of the prior archive to enforce a strict disk bound.

recommendation.title: Retain bounded history
recommendation.body: Keep a bounded archive set or compact retained entries so repeated overflow does not silently erase prior quarantine evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly signaled in the latest review cycle for the affected cron persistence path.
